WAIT ONE ROUND: I will not issue announce_plan this round. I want to observe all four drivers' commitments before making decisions, since my best first move depends on the full configuration (zone-by-zone capacities and rider demand). Waiting is not a commitment that loses anything.

RATIONALIZATION: With 16 total driver-capacity slots and 13 riders total, the optimal strategy is to spread drivers across multiple zones to avoid any zone where riders outnumber available capacity. Concentrating all drivers in one zone (e.g., zone 0) would leave zones 1-3 with 0 capacity and force prices into the 15-30 range there. By distributing drivers as 2 in zone 0, 2 in zone 1, 1 in zone 2, and 1 in zone 3, every zone can keep capacity (8/8/4/4) above its riders (6/4/2/1), keeping the base price of 10 across the board. This should minimize the platform's price penalty and maximize the chance that all 13 riders can be served at their private limits.

So the real goal is to concentrate in the zones with the most riders (zone 0 and zone 1) to minimize price exposure, while leaving zones 2 and 3 to whoever else decides what happens there.
